title: Learning-Based Ad Auction Design with Externalities: The Framework and A Matching-Based Approach

problem.claim: Learning-based ad auctions need to account for externalities in online advertising.

gap.claim: Existing approaches neglect externalities such as interactions between ads and organic items.

contributions.claim: The paper proposes Score-Weighted VCG, a general framework for designing learning-based ad auctions that account for externalities.
The framework decomposes optimal auction design into designing a monotone score function and an allocation algorithm.
The paper presents a matching-based allocation algorithm to implement the proposed framework.

author_reported_evidence.claim: Theoretical results are reported to show optimal incentive-compatible and individually rational auctions under various externality-aware CTR models, with data efficiency and robustness.
Experiments on real-world and synthetic data are reported to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

narrative_sequence.summary: Learning-based ad auctions are increasingly used in online advertising.
Existing approaches neglect externalities involving interactions between ads and organic items.
The paper proposes the Score-Weighted VCG framework for externality-aware learning-based ad auctions.
The framework separates auction design into a monotone score function and an allocation algorithm, and a matching-based allocation method is presented.
The abstract reports theoretical guarantees and experiments on real-world and synthetic data.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify the externality-aware CTR models.
The abstract does not provide theorem statements, assumptions, numerical results, datasets, baselines, or implementation details.
